name: court-deadline-reasoning
display_name: Court Deadline Reasoning & Calendar Drafting for Law Firms
description: One skill: /court-deadline. Supply a trigger date and the applicable rule in plain English; the skill computes the deadline step by step, shows its full reasoning chain so every calculation is auditable, and offers to draft a calendar event. Not a substitute for docketing software — the right tool for one-off and complex date logic where you need to see the work, not just the answer.
